name: Atelier
description: A premium B2B catalogue for mills and manufacturers: split hero, certification strip, product families, case studies and an FAQ, with a CSS-only mobile nav and gallery.

category.label: Product family
category.help: Slug of the category this product belongs to.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.help: Relative paths under images/. Shown as a swipeable strip.

summary.label: Summary
summary.help: One or two lines shown under the family title.

faq.label: Questions
faq.help: A list of question/answer pairs. Rendered as an accordion and emitted as FAQPage structured data.

hero_lede.label: Hero paragraph
hero_lede.default: Bar, plate and tube for aerospace and chemical-process buyers. Rolled, tested and documented at one mill.

stats.label: Stats (value|label ;; value|label)
stats.default: 28 yrs|rolling titanium ;; 42|export countries ;; 1,800 t|shipped last year

certifications.label: Certifications (comma-separated)
certifications.default: ISO 9001, AS9100D, PED 2014/68/EU, NADCAP UT, EN 10204 3.1

band_lede.label: Capability band paragraph
band_lede.default: Melt, roll, test and certify under one roof. Every heat number on the certificate is stamped on the material it describes.

band_features.label: Capability features (Title|text ;; Title|text)
band_features.default: Ultrasonic inspection to AMS-STD-2154|Class A available on bar above 12 mm. ;; Certificates before the goods move|3.1 documents emailed for approval before despatch. ;; A person answers, not a portal|The engineer who quotes your drawing handles the order.

cta_title.label: Bottom CTA title
cta_title.default: Send a drawing. Get a quotation in 24 hours.

cta_lede.label: Bottom CTA text
cta_lede.default: Attach the spec and the tonnage — the person who replies is the person who will roll it.

inquiry_note.label: Text above the inquiry form
inquiry_note.default: Tell us the grade, the form and the tonnage. An engineer replies within one working day.
